content: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><p>We are looking for a Strategy &amp; Operations Manager to join our EMEA Growth &amp; Engagement team, which owns the growth and engagement of Wolt+ and Deliveroo Plus across 40+ markets in Europe and the Middle East and is working to build the best local commerce membership programs in the markets we operate in.</p> <p>You will join our Engagement pod, which focuses on understanding what turns a subscriber into a healthy, engaged and long-term member. You will be responsible for i) identifying and prioritising the largest opportunities to improve our member experience and subscription health, ii) understanding how customer needs and behaviours evolve across different stages of the Plus lifecycle, and iii) driving the highest-priority opportunities from strategy through experimentation and execution to tangible business results.</p> <p>To get the job done, you’ll work closely with our wider subscription team and cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Data Science &amp; Analytics, Marketing, Commercial and Finance, while taking full ownership of driving your initiatives to fruition and, most importantly, measurable results.</p> <p>Our team is responsible for driving

You'll lead strategic improvement initiatives while ensuring efficient inventory management, supplier performance, and operational excellence across the business.</p> <p><strong>Day-to-day in this role you'll:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and manage cross-functional supply chain projects from planning through execution.</li> <li>Identify and drive improvement opportunities in supplier lead times, purchase order confirmations, receiving processes, inventory placement, and cost efficiency.</li> <li>Monitor key supply chain KPIs, analyze performance against targets, identify gaps, and lead improvement initiatives.</li> <li>Analyze operational and performance data to identify trends, exceptions, and actionable business insights.</li> <li>Lead implementation projects and continuously improve supply chain workflows and operational processes.</li> <li>Collaborate with Wolt Market suppliers to improve product availability, optimize assortment, and reduce waste.</li> <li>Partner with multiple internal stakeholders across Operations, Commercial, Logistics, and Product teams to deliver business priorities.</li> <li>Manage supply chain infrastructure and technology, including ERP systems and logistics system integrations.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Our humble expectations</strong></h2> <ul> <li>4+ years of experience in Supply Chain, including demand planning, forecasting, inventory management, or supply planning.</li> <li>Proven experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into operational improvements.</li> <li>Hands-on approach with excell

...fe.</span></p></div><h2>About the Role..</h2> <p>As a Wolt Market Supply Chain Manager, you will play a key role in managing and continuously improving the supply chain for Wolt Market in Finland.</p> <p>You will take ownership of a broad portfolio of Supply Chain responsibilities, including inventory and availability management, demand forecasting, supplier performance and operational supplier management. You will use data and strong commercial judgement to balance availability, inventory, shrinkage, and profitability, ensuring that Supply Chain decisions support both our customers and the overall performance of the business.</p> <p>The role requires a high degree of independence and ownership. You will identify opportunities and challenges, translate analysis into actions, and drive complex Supply Chain initiatives from problem definition through implementation and follow-up with limited guidance.</p> <p>You will work particularly closely with the Finland Supply Chain Analyst and act as an experienced sparring partner to the Finland Category and Store Operations teams. You will also collaborate closely with colleagues across the regional Supply Chain team and the wider Wolt Market Supply Chain community, sharing knowledge, contributing to common initiatives and supporting the continuous development of our Supply Chain capabilities.</p> <h2><strong>Key tasks and responsibilities of the role</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own and drive core Supply Chain responsibilities for Wolt Market Finland together with the local Supply Chain team.</li> <li>Manage and continuously improve inventory availability, stock levels and inventory health while balancing availability, shrinkage, capacity and profitability.</li> <li>Analyse demand, inventory, availability, shrinkage and supplier performance and translate insights into clear recommendations and actions.</li> <li>Own and continuously improve demand forecasting and replenishment processes, including forecasting around promotions, seasonal events and other changes in demand.</li&g
